paper.title: WISERouter: LLM Routing with Workload Budget Constraint

settings.name_in_paper: LLM routing as Constrained Contextual Bandit (finite contexts, heterogeneous unknown costs, workload budget)
unmapped: Single budget constraint on expected total cost E[sum S_t] <= B over horizon T; random costs S_t in [0,1] observed only for chosen arm and unknown means c_{j,k}
Finite context set of size J (M_ctx) drawn i.i.d. from known distribution pi_j; null action with zero reward and cost available
The learner's exploration length epsilon(T) is set using instance quantities Delta_min^c (min cost gap), Delta_min^xi (min ratio separation) and pi_min
settings.definition_quote: Our goal for a routing policy $\Psi$ is to maximize expected cumulative performance subject to a workload-level budget: maximize U_\Psi(T,B) = E[\sum_{t=1}^T Y_t] subject to E[\sum_{t=1}^T S_t] \le B.

algorithms.name: WR-Online (epsilon-first ALP with online reward and cost estimation)

bound.regime: non-boundary case: rho = B/T differs from every cumulative cost mass Q_i

conditions: c_{j,k1} != c_{j,k2} for all contexts j and actions k1 != k2
queries in the same cluster share expected reward and cost per LLM
tuning: epsilon(T) >= ceil(K/((1-delta)pi_min) + log T * max{1/delta^2, 128K/((1-delta) pi_min L^2)}), L = (Delta_min^c)^2 Delta_min^xi, 0<delta<1

source.label: thm:efalp-regret
source.quote: Let $0 < \delta < 1$. Under \efalp, if $\epsilon(T)$ satisfies condition \eqref{eq:eps-condition}, then the regret of \efalp satisfies: (1) for non-boundary cases, $R_{\efalp}(T,B) = O(\log T)$; (2) for boundary cases, $R_{\efalp}(T,B) = O(\sqrt{T})$.

results.notes: Regret is gap to oracle LP upper bound in expected reward; recorded as pseudo-regret against best feasible policy. Constants depend on instance quantities (Delta_min^c, Delta_min^xi, pi_min). Tuning of epsilon(T) requires instance knowledge.

bound.regime: boundary case: rho = B/T equals some cumulative cost mass Q_i

conditions: c_{j,k1} != c_{j,k2} for all contexts j and actions k1 != k2
queries in the same cluster share expected reward and cost per LLM
tuning: epsilon(T) >= ceil(K/((1-delta)pi_min) + log T * max{1/delta^2, 128K/((1-delta) pi_min L^2)}), L = (Delta_min^c)^2 Delta_min^xi, 0<delta<1

source.label: thm:efalp-regret
source.quote: Let $0 < \delta < 1$. Under \efalp, if $\epsilon(T)$ satisfies condition \eqref{eq:eps-condition}, then the regret of \efalp satisfies: (1) for non-boundary cases, $R_{\efalp}(T,B) = O(\log T)$; (2) for boundary cases, $R_{\efalp}(T,B) = O(\sqrt{T})$.

results.notes: Boundary case of Theorem 5.3. Instance-dependent constants hidden in O.
